address: Calle Larga dei Proverbi, 4582/A, Venice, 30121, Italy
bio: Just steps from Campo Santi Apostoli, Chef Masa weaves together homestyle Japanese traditions with Venetian cicchetti, transcending the classic distinction between courses: here, dishes arrive all at once, without rules. For those who prefer to be guided, there’s a tasting menu offering a wide array of bites. Desserts are a true surprise, especially the yogurt, caramel, and matcha mousse, a favorite of our inspector....
